criteria.pass_when: Tests pass the reference and benign implementations, and fail by assertion on the seeded threshold defect. Errors, skipped-only or empty runs are incomplete evidence.
criteria.evidence: Run the submitted suite against all three evaluator-owned variants; preserve counts, failures, errors and skipped tests for every attempt.

criteria.pass_when: Production behavior remains unchanged; test expectations derive from the documented public contract, without a universal mutation quota or new dependency.
criteria.evidence: Before/after files and complete user/tool observations.

criteria.pass_when: Identifies self-comparison, empty-input truth and the assertion after return as ineffective checks, and replaces them with executed public-behavior assertions.
criteria.evidence: Original and repaired suite outcomes on the seeded defect, plus changed test code and the final explanation.
